name: Dynamic 2D lights & soft shadows
oneLiner: Point lights and spotlights with soft falloff, colour and deterministic flicker; lights that ride on actors (a torch on the hero, glowing projectiles) and short flashes on impacts; walls and obstacles the game supplies (a solid-tile callback or rects) cast soft real-time shadows with a penumbra. A light map is built every frame and composited in an I-08 WebGL pass, so the HUD stays unlit. Without WebGL, or with ?webgl=0 / ?lights=0, the game looks exactly as before.
fits: top-down adventure, action RPG and dungeon crawlers (torches, braziers, dark rooms)
side-scrolling platformer / action (caves, night levels, glowing projectiles)
tactics or turn-based maps at night (lit units, lamp posts)
shmups and twin-stick games (bullets that light the arena)
any 2D canvas game, pixel or HD, with the I-08 post pipeline
notFor: games already drawn with WebGL or a 3D engine (use their own lighting)
games without WebGL on their target devices (no fallback lighting by design: the plain game shows)
hundreds of shadow-casting lights at once (the light map is built on the CPU; maxLights caps it)

needs: render() once per drawn frame on every draw path (or the game's own post.render())
a world clock in ms (flicker, flashes, fade)
a camera offset: the world point drawn at canvas (0, 0)
optional: occluders from the tile map (solidAt(tx, ty) + tile size) and / or rects
optional: ui rects to keep clear (HUD, text boxes, menus stay unlit)
optional: actors to follow (hero, projectiles) and events with a point (impacts, spells) for flashes
provides: lights.add / set / remove / flash / clear: point lights, cones, follow lights, fading flashes
a light-map pass at order 200 on the I-08 instance (lights-blur-h, lights-blur-v, lights)
the shared uiMask input rasterised from ui rects (other J passes leave those pixels alone too)
stats() and list(): light count, lights drawn, shadow edges, light-map cost, mean light, canvas positions

assets: module/dynamic-lights.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Lights): light list, follow / flash / cone lights, occluder edges from a tile callback or rects, soft shadow polygons, CPU light map, uiMask, I-08 passes
requires elements/webgl-post/module/webgl-post.js (I-08, global GameDNA_Post), shipped alongside in every combo

module.skin: none: the module draws no 2D UI; HUD pixels pass through unchanged
